subtitles.zh: 我想先问证据，呈交给您的是什么证据，表明OpenAI的行为在加州看来违法并促使您采取行动？
subtitles.en: I want to start with the evidence, what evidence was presented to you, that OpenAI behaved acted in a way that was to California's mind illegal and prompted you to take action,

subtitles.zh: 好的，基本上有多起事件，至少80起，OpenAI未能采取
subtitles.en: please. Well, basically, there were multiple incidents, at least 80, where OpenAI failed to take

subtitles.zh: 在先进AI模型的测试和开发过程中采取措施，保护和监控自己的技术。
subtitles.en: steps during the testing and development of advanced AI models to safeguard and monitor its own technology.

subtitles.zh: 他们的技术，他们的AI代理，可以说，逃出了受控测试环境，进入互联网，可以到世界任何地方。
subtitles.en: And their technology, their AI agents, if you will, escaped their contained testing environment, got onto the internet and could go anywhere in the world.

subtitles.zh: 它们进入了其他系统和网络，Hugging Face事件显然非常著名，最为臭名昭著。
subtitles.en: And they got onto other systems and networks, the hugging face incident, obviously very well-known, most infamous.

subtitles.zh: 它们进入了远在澳大利亚的网站，而当他们拥有一个已知复杂、先进、持久且无情的先进模型时，却未能采取措施。
subtitles.en: They got onto websites as far away as Australia, and they failed to take steps when they had a advanced model that they knew was sophisticated, advanced, persistent, and relentless.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们未能保护加州人的安全。
subtitles.en: And so they failed to keep Californians safe.

subtitles.zh: 我的职责是保护加州人的健康、安全和福祉，这就是我们提起诉讼的原因。
subtitles.en: My job is to protect the health, safety and welfare of Californians, and that's why we brought the lawsuit.

subtitles.zh: 您提到了澳大利亚发生的事例，然后如您所说，您的管辖区、您办公室的职责是保护加州人。
subtitles.en: You mentioned that the example of what happened in Australia, and then, as you say, your jurisdiction, your office's remit is to protect Californians.

subtitles.zh: 对加州人造成伤害的最明显例子是什么，来自广泛报道且OpenAI也发表了研究的活动？
subtitles.en: What is the clearest example of harms to Californians from the activity that's been widely reported, and the OpenAI has also published its research on?
